# Novaleo Weight & Wellness - Detailed Profile

Novaleo Weight & Wellness is a modern telehealth platform built for professional women in Michigan and Wisconsin, specializing in hormones, metabolic health, and weight resistance. Guided by Kathryn Long, NP-C, the platform delivers root-cause functional medicine.

## About the Founder
Kathryn Long, NP-C, is an experienced healthcare professional dedicated to uncovering the root causes of health issues rather than just treating symptoms. She brings a personalized, comprehensive approach to every patient, supporting them in navigating complex health challenges like fatigue, brain fog, hormone imbalances, and weight resistance.

## Core Services & Focus Areas
- **Hormone Optimization:** Helping women balance hormones naturally for better energy, mood, and sleep.
- **Metabolic Health:** Addressing underlying metabolic dysfunction to support sustainable weight loss and overall vitality.
- **Weight Resistance:** Uncovering the hidden barriers that make weight loss difficult, even when traditional labs are "normal."
- **Root-Cause Functional Medicine:** Comprehensive diagnostic testing and personalized treatment plans tailored to each individual.

## Patient Experience
Novaleo offers a seamless, modern telehealth experience. Patients can easily book a free 15-minute discovery call to see if the approach is a good fit. Paid clarity sessions are also available for deeper dives into complex health concerns.
